name: Boostly – Conversion & Sales Booster for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Boostly is a modular WooCommerce plugin that adds Quick View, Sticky Add to Cart, Direct Checkout, Trust Badges, Free Shipping Bar, and more to your store — in one lightweight, performance-first toolkit. Enable only the modules you need. Disabled modules load zero CSS and zero JavaScript.

📖 Documentation

Every disabled module contributes zero CSS, zero JavaScript, and zero database queries to your page. Active modules load assets only on the exact pages where they render.

⚡ 10 WooCommerce Conversion Modules — 100% Free

1. Quick View for WooCommerce
Let shoppers preview full product details — images, description, price, variations — in a modal popup without leaving the shop page. Includes AJAX add-to-cart and variable product support with variation selectors.

2. Sticky Add to Cart for WooCommerce
A floating sticky bar that keeps the Add to Cart button always visible as customers scroll. Shows product thumbnail, title, price, and quantity. On variable products, the bar’s button scrolls shoppers back to the variation form so they can choose their options.

3. Direct Checkout / Buy Now Button
Skip the cart entirely. One click sends shoppers straight to WooCommerce checkout. Works on simple and variable products. Reduces cart abandonment for high-intent buyers.

4. Free Shipping Progress Bar
Animated progress bar showing how much more the shopper needs to unlock free shipping. v1.1.3: choose “Auto-detect” to read the minimum order amount straight from your WooCommerce Free shipping method (matched to the customer’s shipping zone), or keep typing the amount yourself. v1.1.2: Updates in real-time via AJAX when items are added or removed — no page reload needed. Includes an optional 🎉 confetti burst when the goal is reached.

5. WooCommerce Sales Notifications
Recent purchase popups powered by real WooCommerce orders, virtual demo entries, or mixed mode. v1.1.2: Clicking a notification now opens the product page directly — turning social proof into a navigation tool.

6. Stock Scarcity & Urgency Messages
Two-tier urgency: a low-stock warning and a critical-stock alert with animated bar. Use {stock} in your message to auto-insert the live count — “Only {stock} left!”

7. Recently Viewed Products
Horizontal product carousel powered by browser localStorage — zero server load, zero database writes. Encourages return visits to products customers were considering.

8. Trust Badges for WooCommerce
12 inline SVG payment and security badges — no external CDN, no privacy risk. Supports up to 5 custom badges — your own label with an emoji and/or an image from your Media Library (“Halal Certified”, “30-Day Returns”, etc.). v1.1.2: Optional checkout page placement below the Place Order button — the highest-hesitation moment in your funnel.

9. WhatsApp Order Button (new in 1.1.3)
An “Order on WhatsApp” button on product pages and, optionally, shop listings. It is a plain wa.me link with a pre-filled message (product, price, link and — on variable products — the options the shopper picked). No API, no tracking, no script from WhatsApp; nothing is contacted until a visitor clicks.

10. Sale Countdown Timer (new in 1.1.3)
Counts down to the real end date of a WooCommerce scheduled sale. No end date, no timer — there are no fake or evergreen countdowns. Counts client-side, so it works with page caching.

⚡ What’s New in v1.1.3

Hide modules where you don’t want them
Every product-level module now has a Visibility tab to hide it in chosen product categories (sub-categories included), plus a Boostly — Visibility box on the product edit screen to hide modules on a single product.

WhatsApp Order Button and Sale Countdown Timer — two new free modules (see above).

Shipping Bar — auto-detect threshold
Read the free shipping minimum from WooCommerce itself so the bar always agrees with checkout.

Trust Badges — custom image badges
Pick badge images from the Media Library (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP). SVG uploads are intentionally not accepted. Badges can also be shown after the Place Order button of the WooCommerce Checkout block.

Tools — settings import / export
Back up or copy your Boostly setup as a JSON file (Boostly → Tools). Imports are validated and every value is sanitised.

⚡ What’s New in v1.1.2

Shipping Bar — Real-time AJAX Update
The Free Shipping Bar now refreshes instantly when items are added or removed from the cart — in the mini cart, cart page, checkout, and sticky bar — without any page reload. This was the #1 missing feature compared to dedicated shipping bar plugins.

Shipping Bar — Confetti Celebration
When a customer unlocks free shipping, a lightweight confetti burst fires automatically. Pure CSS keyframe animation — no external library, no performance cost. Toggle it on or off in settings.

Trust Badges — Checkout Page Support
Enable badges on the Checkout page to display them below the Place Order button — the moment hesitation peaks just before payment. One checkbox in settings.

Sales Notifications — Click-to-Product
Clicking any notification popup now navigates the shopper to that product’s page. Product URLs are pulled directly from real WooCommerce order data — zero configuration needed.

🏆 Why Boostly Outperforms Separate Plugins

Most WooCommerce stores install 5–8 separate conversion plugins. Each loads its own scripts, stylesheets, and database queries — even on pages where nothing renders.

Boostly is built differently:

  • Modular toggle — disabled modules are completely excluded from page output
  • Page-aware loading — Quick View scripts only on shop pages; Sticky ATC only on product pages
  • Lightweight assets — each module ships its own small CSS/JS; average module weight under 15 KB (unminified), and nothing loads for disabled modules
  • One settings dashboard — all 10 modules in a single admin screen with individual tabs
  • WooCommerce-native hooks — no template overrides
  • HPOS compatible — declared via WooCommerce FeaturesUtil API
  • Translation-ready — .pot file included for GlotPress

External services

The WhatsApp Order Button module (optional, off by default) outputs a link to https://wa.me/<number>?text=<message>, a click-to-chat link operated by WhatsApp (Meta). The plugin itself makes no request to WhatsApp and sends no data; the link is only followed when a visitor clicks the button, at which point WhatsApp’s own terms and privacy policy apply: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service and https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy.

No other module contacts an external service.
sections.installation:
From WordPress.org (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Boostly” or “WooCommerce sales booster”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  5. Navigate to Boostly in your admin menu.
  6. Enable the modules you want and configure each one from its settings tab.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the zip and activate.
sections.faq:
Will Boostly slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Disabled modules load zero assets — no CSS, no JavaScript, no database queries. Active modules load their assets only on pages where they render. Quick View scripts never load on the checkout page, for example.

Does the Free Shipping Bar update in real-time?

Yes, as of v1.1.2. The bar refreshes instantly via AJAX whenever items are added or removed from the cart — no page reload needed. This works in the mini cart, cart page, checkout page, and sticky bar.

Does Quick View work with variable products (sizes, colors, etc.)?

Yes. The Quick View modal renders the complete WooCommerce variation form — dropdowns, price updates, and stock messages — exactly as on the single product page.

Does the Sticky Add to Cart bar work on variable products?

Yes. On variable products the sticky bar hides the quantity selector, and its button scrolls shoppers back to the variation form so they can choose size, color or other options before adding to cart. Choosing options directly inside the bar is not supported yet.

Can I show the Sticky Add to Cart on mobile only or desktop only?

Yes. Mobile and desktop visibility are independently controlled in the Sticky Add to Cart module settings.

Can I show Trust Badges on the Checkout page?

Yes. Enable “Show on Checkout page” in Trust Badges settings and badges will appear below the Place Order button — the highest-hesitation moment in the purchase funnel.

What are “Custom Text Badges” in the Trust Badges module?

Add up to 5 personalized badges with your own text — “30-Day Free Returns”, “Halal Certified”, “Made in Bangladesh”, “24/7 Support” etc. Enter your label and choose one of 12 emoji icons and/or an image from your Media Library.

How do I hide a module on one product or category?

Open the module’s settings and use the Visibility tab to hide it in product categories (sub-categories are included). To hide it on a single product, tick the module in the Boostly — Visibility box on that product’s edit screen.

Does the WhatsApp Order Button send data to WhatsApp?

No. The button is an ordinary link to https://wa.me/. Nothing is sent, and WhatsApp is not contacted, unless a visitor clicks it. See “External services” below.

Can the Sale Countdown show a timer for sales without an end date?

No, by design. It only counts down to the end date you set in the product’s scheduled sale, so the urgency is always genuine. For variable products it is shown only when every on-sale variation has an end date.

How do I move my settings to another store?

Go to Boostly → Tools, export a JSON file, then import it on the other site. Custom trust-badge images are not included (Media Library IDs differ between sites) and your WhatsApp number is only included if you tick the option.

Is my data deleted when I delete the plugin?

Not by default. Tick “Delete all Boostly data when the plugin is deleted” in Boostly → Tools if you want a full clean-up.

Will clicking a Sales Notification take shoppers to the product page?

Yes, if enabled. Turn on “Clicking a notification opens the product page” in Sales Notifications settings and each popup becomes a clickable link to that product.

Are Trust Badges loaded from an external CDN?

No. Every badge is an inline SVG rendered server-side. Zero external requests.

Is Boostly GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Recently Viewed uses browser localStorage only. The viewer counter is entirely browser-side. Sales Notifications virtual mode uses no real customer data.

Is Boostly compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Full HPOS compatibility declared via the WooCommerce FeaturesUtil API.

Does Boostly work with block themes and FSE?

Yes. All modules inject via standard WooCommerce hooks — no theme template overrides.

How many modules can I enable at once?

All 8. Each is independent — only active modules load assets, only on the pages they render.

Does Boostly create custom database tables?

No. Settings are stored in the WordPress options table (one option per module). No custom tables, no scheduled cron jobs.

Where can I get support?

Post in the Boostly support forum on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • New: Visibility controls — per-category tab on every product-level module (sub-categories included) and a “Boostly — Visibility” box on the product edit screen. One central check (Boostly_Exclusions::should_render()) is used by every module.
  • New: WhatsApp Order Button module (wa.me link, pre-filled message with product, price, link and chosen variation).
  • New: Sale Countdown Timer module — driven only by real WooCommerce sale end dates, client-side countdown, cache-friendly.
  • New: Free Shipping Bar — “Auto-detect” threshold source reads the minimum amount of the matching WooCommerce Free shipping method. “Manual” remains the default, so existing sites behave exactly as before.
  • New: Trust Badges — custom badges (label + emoji and/or Media Library image; JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP only) and optional output after the Checkout block’s Place order button.
  • New: Boostly → Tools — settings export / import (JSON, schema_version 1, validated and sanitised on import).
  • Change: Deleting the plugin now keeps your settings unless “Delete all Boostly data when the plugin is deleted” is ticked under Boostly → Tools. Per-product visibility meta is removed with the rest when that option is on.
  • Change: Per-module “Reset to defaults” also clears that module’s category visibility rules.
  • Improvement: the Free Shipping Bar {threshold} placeholder now shows the threshold actually in use.
  • Removed: the Pro upgrade card, topbar button, “Go Pro” plugin link and all related code, so the plugin no longer contains any upgrade promotion.
  • Fix: Sales Notifications “Real orders only” no longer falls back to generated demo notifications when the store has no qualifying orders; nothing is shown until real orders exist. Generated entries appear only in Virtual and Mixed modes, which show the demonstration label.

1.1.2

  • New: Free Shipping Bar — real-time AJAX update via woocommerce_add_to_cart_fragments. Bar now refreshes instantly in mini cart, cart page, checkout, and sticky bar without any page reload.
  • New: Free Shipping Bar — optional confetti celebration animation when free shipping threshold is reached. Lightweight pure-CSS keyframe particles — no external library.
  • New: Trust Badges — “Show on Checkout page” toggle. On the classic checkout, badges render directly above the Place Order button via the woocommerce_review_order_before_submit hook.
  • New: Sales Notifications — “Clicking a notification opens the product page” toggle. Product URL sourced from real WooCommerce order data and set as a data-product-url attribute; JS handles the redirect on click.
  • Improvement: Free Shipping Bar cart_fragments() now returns separate fragments for mini_cart, cart, checkout, and sticky contexts — each updates independently.
  • Note: Stock Scarcity {stock} placeholder was already implemented in v1.1.1 — added to changelog for visibility.

1.1.1

  • New: Trust Badges — custom text badges. Add up to 5 personalized badges with emoji icons and your own text.
  • New: Translation template (.pot file) — 302 translatable strings for GlotPress.
  • Fix: Trust Badges SVG output uses wp_kses() with explicit allowlist.
  • Fix: Trust Badges admin — inline style values wrapped with esc_attr().
  • Fix: Sales Notifications virtual/mixed mode shows “For demonstration purposes” disclosure on storefront.
  • Fix: load_plugin_textdomain() added — translations load correctly.
  • Fix: “Tested up to” updated to WordPress 7.1.

1.1.0

  • New: Redesigned admin dashboard — two-column module grid with status indicators.
  • New: Plugin and WooCommerce version display in dashboard.
  • Improvement: Removed promotional UI from module settings screens.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Colour picker values not saving correctly on second save in Quick View and Direct Checkout design tabs.
  • Fix: “Saved” confirmation incorrectly shown when switching tabs without saving.

1.0.0

  • Initial release — 8 modules: Quick View, Direct Checkout, Sticky Add to Cart, Free Shipping Bar, Sales Notifications, Stock Scarcity, Recently Viewed Products, Trust Badges.
  • Full WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
  • Translation-ready.
